summary:
Main
Iron ore futures, Qingdao port spot products and seaborne quotes firmed in tandem today, while the high-grade port composite indexdiverged slightly. DCE most-traded closed at 658.5 yuan/mt, up 0.69% from Nov 23. All eight Qingdao spot products including PB Fines, Newman Fines, Mac Fines and Carajas Fines gained 5 yuan/wmt; port 61% and 58% indices climbed to 642 and 601 yuan/wmt while the 65% port composite index edged down 2 yuan to 800 yuan/wmt.
